simulation_brief.summary: A fictional suburb is considering allowing fourplexes near train stations. Renters generally support added housing supply, homeowners fear traffic and neighborhood change, builders seek predictable rules, school officials worry about enrollment and capacity planning, the planning commission can only recommend, and the council holds final voting authority. T0 centers on unresolved coalition formation, legitimacy framing, and endpoint uncertainty around passage, delay, exemption carve-outs, or backlash slate formation.
